prompt: Write a lua script for Mudlet that will take the phrase, “You have emptied yarrow out of your pipe” and will both refill the pipe based on GMCP values and send me a rime.echo prompt letting me know that the pipe is refilled. This should also include the reflex needed for this message to work with yarrow, myrrh, and poptarts
response:
```lua
-- Define a function to refill the pipe
function refillPipe(herb)
    local gmcpHerb = gmcp.Char.Inventory[herb]
    if gmcpHerb and gmcpHerb.amount > 0 then
        send("use " .. herb .. " with pipe")
        rime.echo("Your pipe is now refilled with " .. herb .. ".")
    else
        rime.echo("You don't have any " .. herb .. " left.")
    end
end

-- Create a reflex for the specific phrase
reflex:new("You have emptied (yarrow|myrrh|poptarts) out of your pipe", function(m)
    local herb = m:match("You have emptied (%w+) out of your pipe")
    refillPipe(herb)
end)
```
This script defines a function `refillPipe` that checks the GMCP inventory for the specified herb and refills the pipe if available. It also includes a reflex that triggers on the specified phrase and calls the `refillPipe` function with the correct herb.
